title: Real-Time Multi-Sensor 3D Mapping Pipeline for Agricultural Robotics
headline: Jetson Orin · RGB-D + LiDAR fusion · Gaussian Splatting-ready output
description: Real-time SLAM and 3D mapping pipeline fusing RealSense RGB-D/IMU and LiDAR on Jetson Orin for autonomous agricultural field mapping, feeding downstream Gaussian Splatting reconstruction.
highlights: LiDAR-camera extrinsic calibration via Koide direct visual-LiDAR method
Distributed multi-machine ROS 2 over Tailscale-meshed FastDDS discovery
KISS-ICP odometry tuned for stable outdoor trajectories
learned: Distributed ROS 2 discovery over mesh networks

title: RL-based Robotic Manipulation with Koopman Operator
headline: 30% faster task completion · 40% smoother motion
description: RL-based robotic picking system using Isaac Sim + PPO, layering a Koopman-operator linear model on top to approximate the arm's non-linear dynamics for smoother control. Designed the reward function and sim-to-real transfer path from scratch.
highlights: 30% faster task completion against the un-linearized baseline
25% fewer collision errors against the un-linearized baseline
40% less erratic motion against the un-linearized baseline

title: Indoor Mapping with Semantic 3D SLAM
headline: 95% mapping accuracy · 70% better navigation
description: Semantic 3D SLAM fusing RTAB-Map and ORB-SLAM3 with instance segmentation on a TurtleBot 3, producing semantically labeled 3D maps for GPS-denied indoor navigation, validated first in Isaac Sim.
highlights: 95% mapping and localization accuracy against the landmark-tracked map
70% better navigation efficiency over the unfused baseline
Dynamic obstacle avoidance layered on top of the semantic map

title: Autonomous Drone 3D Mapping with Stereo SLAM
headline: Custom stereo rig · GPS-denied flight · real-time 3D maps
description: Solo build of a GPS-denied navigation stack on a custom quadcopter: a hand-calibrated stereo rig of two Raspberry Pi cameras feeding ORB-SLAM3 and RTAB-Map for real-time visual-inertial localization and mapping, run on a Jetson Orin Nano paired with a Pixhawk flight controller over ROS 2.
highlights: Hand-calibrated stereo rig built from two Raspberry Pi cameras
Real-time visual-inertial SLAM on a Jetson Orin Nano
Validated end to end in simulation, with fallback logic for SLAM tracking loss, before flight testing

title: Image-Based Visual Servoing for Robotic Arm
headline: <5ms inference · real-time visual feedback control
description: Real-time visual feedback control for precise robotic arm manipulation using stereo vision + YOLOv8.
highlights: TensorRT optimization: <5ms inference
3D point cloud from disparity maps
Dynamic visual servoing control

title: Custom Quadcopter Design & Development
headline: 2.8km range · 20min flight time · 6kg payload
description: End-to-end quadcopter build — component selection to autonomous flight with extended range and payload.
highlights: 2.8km range with constant telemetry
20-minute flight, 6kg payload
Autonomous flight modes unlocked by the long-range telemetry link

title: Image Super Resolution — SRGAN
headline: 720p → 4K upscaling · 40% less GPU memory
description: SRGAN for real-time video upscaling from 720p to 4K with heavy memory optimization.
highlights: 720p → 4K upscaling
40% less GPU memory usage
Dynamic memory allocation for large videos
learned: Speed vs quality trade-offs in SR

title: Real-Time Audio Noise Cancellation
headline: Wave-UNet architecture · MSE ~0.2 · real-time
description: Deep learning noise cancellation using Wave-UNet with one-cycle learning on Mozilla Common Voice + UrbanSound8k.
highlights: Wave-UNet architecture
MSE loss ~0.2
One Cycle LR optimization

title: Pothole Detection System
headline: mAP > 0.85 @ IoU 0.95 · ResNet50 + RetinaNet
description: Pothole detector built on a RetinaNet head over a ResNet50 backbone, with a semi-synthetic data-generation pipeline and a heavy Albumentations augmentation stack to compensate for limited labeled data, trained and evaluated against PascalVOC/COCO-format annotations.
highlights: mAP > 0.85 at IoU 0.95
Semi-synthetic data generation
Albumentations augmentation pipeline
learned: Albumentations-based augmentation to offset limited labeled data

title: Manipulator Simulation & Control Pipeline
headline: 6-DOF SO-101 arm · Jacobian IK from first principles · MuJoCo sim-to-control
description: Full sim-to-control pipeline built from scratch in MuJoCo for a 6-DOF SO-101 arm, from MJCF validation tooling through a first-principles inverse-kinematics solver.
highlights: Diagnostic tooling validating a community MJCF conversion against joint/actuator/body topology
Joint-by-joint sinusoidal sweep to sanity-check actuator wiring and limits
Jacobian-based damped least-squares IK solver built from first principles for circular-trajectory tracking

title: Isaac Lab Manipulation Environment
headline: 7D IK-delta + 9D joint-delta teleop · Isaac Lab 3.0 beta migration
description: Manager-based Gym task package in NVIDIA Isaac Lab for the SO-101 arm, registering training and teleoperation environments through isaaclab.devices.
highlights: Manager-based Gym task package registering three training/teleoperation environments
7D IK-delta-plus-gripper and 9D joint-delta teleoperation action spaces via isaaclab.devices
Diagnosed a stale table-height assumption and quaternion-ordering bug via runtime bounding-box measurement
learned: Working through pre-release breaking changes (WXYZ to XYZW quaternion flip)
